name: Input Assist
description: Tick-based click delay and jump buffering for mistimed inputs.

enabled.name: Enable Input Assist
enabled.description: Master switch. Takes effect immediately, even mid-level.

press-delay.name: Click Delay (ticks)
press-delay.description:
Every click <cy>and</c> release is applied this many physics ticks later. GD runs at <cg>240 ticks per second</c>, so 1 tick is about <cg>4.2 ms</c>.

Helps if you consistently click slightly early. Because releases move by the same amount, how long you hold is unchanged.

<cy>1</c> is the subtlest setting. <cy>0</c> turns the delay off.

buffer-ticks.name: Buffer Ticks
buffer-ticks.description:
Every press is held for <cy>at least</c> this many ticks before its release is applied.

A tap you release just before landing, or just before entering an orb, then still counts as a jump. Holds that are already longer than this are not changed.

<cy>0</c> turns buffering off.

affect-movement.name: Affect Platformer Movement
affect-movement.description: Also apply the delay and buffer to left/right in platformer levels. When off, only jump inputs are adjusted.

practice-only.name: Practice Mode Only
practice-only.description: Only adjust inputs while practice mode is on. Normal attempts play exactly like vanilla.

show-indicator.name: Show Indicator
show-indicator.description: Shows a small label in the top-left corner of a level while the assist is active.
